title: Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai — real TN cadastrals
description: Real TNGIS and NCSCM cadastral parcels (two independent government surveys of the same land), real OpenStreetMap and Microsoft AI buildings and roads. Chitta/Patta, corporation tax, utility and other records are simulated on the real parcels because they are not open data.
real_notes: The two cadastral layers are compared with each other: their agreement is a real measurement with no simulated answer key. The TNGIS map sits about 6.0 m from the imagery-traced buildings; the simulated DGPS survey is placed on the ground, so the pipeline has to find and correct that offset.
simulated_notes: Chitta / Patta (Tamil pattadar names), Greater Chennai Corporation tax, TANGEDCO, CMWSSB, gas, CMDA permissions, TNREGINET deeds, DGPS and field visits: simulated on the real parcels.
Elevation (DSM, DTM) and the 2021 survey: simulated on the real footprints.
Encroachment and cadastral-error scores are not reported here: the parcels are real, so there is no answer key for them.
